title: Fresh Spec
definition: A new, tailored machine learning model specification document based on the insights from a postmortem analysis.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A custom-built recipe for a machine learning model, using the lessons learned from a failed model to make it better.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A revised machine learning model specification that incorporates the insights from a postmortem analysis, aiming to address the shortcomings of the previous model.
difficulty_levels.expert: A carefully crafted model specification that takes into account the insights gained from a postmortem analysis. It ensures that every field is justified by either something the postmortem flagged as missing or something that demonstrably worked and should be preserved, with a focus on voice_negative and drift_zones.

extra_fields.insight: A fresh specification is the key to correcting the mistakes of a failed model and creating a better one.
